title: The Boat Procession
offer: Midsummer again! This year, all the boats row in a line with torches. Bring three crates of mead, and four torches from Orm in Hallvik: your boat leads the line!

steps.say: Mead for after the procession. Now the torches.

steps.load_say: My best tar torches, from the ones you helped me make!

steps.say: Twenty boats in a line, and you in front, with the dragon head! The torches shine on the water. The most beautiful night of the year.

fact: At midsummer, the sun barely sets in the north: the night stays light.
